originality.rationale: The exact all-lag covariance is not the stationary equal-time covariance or a reparametrization of it: its three physically distinct decay exponents, strict all-lag sign, the unique harmonic-mean pole crossing and positive double-pole term require propagating the shared stiffness history. Biroli et al. (arXiv:2312.02570) derive the one-time joint law and its equal-time quadratic covariance; their accessible main text contains no all-lag squared-position result. The experimental follow-up (arXiv:2508.07199) reports stationary quadratic and hydrodynamically induced lagged linear observables. Frydel (arXiv:2407.12213) treats a zero-stiffness on/off limit. Behme (arXiv:2407.05866) supplies general Markov-modulated OU covariance machinery, but its stated results are not the sharp physical two-particle decay/resonance classification. Wider stochastic-volatility priority remains a risk; no novelty claim is based solely on search absence.
